> [!TIP]
> I’m excited to introduce MetroVerse v1.1.0! It builds on the podcast transcripts, on-device subtitle generation, bilingual podcast subtitles, smoother lyrics, and InnerTubeX playback introduced in v1.0.0. >
> 很高兴带来全新的 MetroVerse v1.1.0！本次更新延续了 v1.0.0 的播客原生字幕、端侧模型识别字幕、播客字幕翻译、优化的歌词显示，以及 InnerTubeX 播放体验，并加入四种语言识别、更多翻译服务与字幕恢复改进。欢迎升级，体验新功能！

## What’s new

- **Four recognition languages:** Experimental on-device RSS podcast recognition now supports English, German, Spanish, and Japanese. Choose a language for an episode or save a channel default, with separate model download and deletion controls.
- **Improved subtitle recovery:** Reopen unfinished subtitles from saved progress, retry recoverable recognition failures automatically, and re-recognize the current episode or copy its original subtitles from the subtitle menu.
- **More translation services:** Added DeepSeek, Z.ai, MiniMax, Kimi, SiliconFlow, and ModelScope presets. Custom API roots are completed automatically, and custom model names can be entered directly.
- **Independent podcast translation:** Set a separate target language and system prompt for podcast subtitles, or toggle translation for the current episode. Larger background batches reduce small requests; error messages dismiss after six seconds.
- **Refined subtitle controls:** Updated recognition buttons, language and model dialogs, model status, and timing adjustment. Unsupported recognition languages are explained, and the region picker now says Mainland China.
- **Playback fixes:** Podcast tiles in Speed dial retain episode playback behavior. Disabling autoplay now pauses the local player at the end of each item, and RSS playback no longer inherits the previous track’s normalization gain.

## Before you update

- Requires **Android 8.0 or newer and an ARM64 device**.
- On-device recognition is **experimental and available for RSS podcasts in English, German, Spanish, and Japanese**. YouTube Music podcasts do not offer it. Download the selected language’s speech model before use.
- Speech recognition runs on your device. Optional AI translation requires your own API configuration and sends subtitle text to your chosen provider.
- Re-recognizing an episode replaces its saved subtitles, recognition progress, and subtitle translations.
- Existing audio-quality preferences are preserved.

## 主要更新

- **四种语言识别：** 实验性 RSS 播客端侧识别现支持英语、德语、西班牙语和日语。可为单集选择语言或保存频道默认语言，并分别下载、删除各语言模型。
- **字幕恢复改进：** 重新打开未完成的字幕时优先显示已保存进度；可恢复的识别失败会自动尝试重试；字幕菜单支持重新识别当前单集或复制原文字幕。
- **更多翻译服务：** 新增 DeepSeek、Z.ai、MiniMax、Kimi、硅基流动和魔搭预设。自定义 API 根地址自动补全，可直接输入自定义模型名称。
- **独立播客翻译设置：** 播客字幕可单独设置目标语言和系统提示词，也可仅为当前单集开关翻译。扩大后台批次以减少零散请求，错误提示六秒后自动隐藏。
- **字幕操作优化：** 调整识别按钮、语言与模型弹窗、模型状态和时间校准。明确提示暂不支持的识别语言，地区选择器改为显示「中国大陆」。
- **播放修复：** 快捷播放中的播客保留单集播放行为；关闭自动播放后，本机播放器会在每个项目结束时暂停；RSS 播放不再沿用上一首音乐的响度增益。

## 更新说明

- 需要 **Android 8.0 或更新系统，以及 ARM64 设备**。
- 端侧识别是面向 **RSS 播客的实验性功能，支持英语、德语、西班牙语和日语**；YouTube Music 播客不提供此入口。使用前需下载所选语言的语音模型。
- 语音识别在本机运行。可选的 AI 翻译需要自行配置 API，字幕文本会发送给你选择的服务。
- 重新识别单集会替换该单集已保存的字幕、识别进度和字幕翻译。
- 已保存的音质偏好保持不变。
